card.summary: 'completely cost-free forever', capped in the FAQ: 'Our advanced web app allows you to generate up to 8 premium links daily'.

free_tier.stated: 'completely cost-free forever', capped in the FAQ: 'Our advanced web app allows you to generate up to 8 premium links daily'.

per_object_cap.stated: 'Zero file size restrictions - process files of any size immediately.'

retention.stated: 'Auto-purge technology rapidly eliminates your links after completion'

egress.terms: '100% unlimited bandwidth with rapid processing technology'

record.interface_detail: Web form with a 'Get Premium Link' button; no API, CLI or plugin documented.
record.chaining: Same slot as the rest of the family; the name collides with the unrelated open-source Mega downloader, so a client searching for tooling finds the wrong project first.
record.limits_note: '+100 cloud providers' with no list on the home page.
record.binding_note: Eight links a day with session-token links; no byte cap is documented, so the link count is the only named limit.

identity_cost.detail: No account, no email; 'Unique session-based links with one-time access tokens'.

record.reliability_note: One-time session tokens mean an interrupted download cannot be resumed from the same link; no status page.
record.confidence_note: Cap and flow vendor-stated, read; enforcement untested.

evidence.proved: 'generate up to 8 premium links daily', 'completely cost-free forever', '+100 cloud providers', 'one-time access tokens'

record.notes: Fourth member of the 8-a-day template family.
